text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. I need it for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
Two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers come up in Moss's notes:

1. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated). Thea Ramaswell logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing.
2. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Thea submitted it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments when they checked in on the tablet. Support patched the SMS gateway routing that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's shift got through the gate without anyone stepping in. The note also says the Eau Claire kiosk logs were to be archived before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.

Moss has six notes in the brain, and I went through all of them. The other four mention Quarrendon but give no ticket numbers. Two of those are the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in. The tickets in the Central handoffs note (#4409, #4412, FR-882) belong to the Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon.

Check #4419 before it goes in the deck. Marcus's own note "Q2 expansion wrap" (14 Jul 2025) also cites #4419 for Quarrendon, but describes it as Gate 3 printer lag on BOL printouts. That doesn't match Moss's description of Door 14 scanners. One of them may have the wrong number, so it's worth asking Dana or Marcus which is right.
